tables.telemetry: Temperature and humidity readings produced by store freezers.
tables.work_orders: Maintenance work orders. Open and In Progress are active statuses.

columns.telemetry.temperature_c: Temperature in degrees Celsius. A reading warmer than -15 C is over-temperature.

views.name: telemetry_enriched
views.sql: SELECT t.event_id, t.freezer_id, t.event_time, t.temperature_c, t.humidity_pct, f.criticality, s.store_name FROM {schema}.telemetry t JOIN {schema}.freezers f ON t.freezer_id = f.freezer_id JOIN {schema}.stores s ON f.store_id = s.store_id

metricView.name: freezer_health_metrics
metricView.comment: Governed cold-chain health metrics for Genie

genie.title: Cold Chain Maintenance
sampleQuestions: Which high-criticality freezers had at least three readings warmer than -15 C during the latest 24-hour period in the dataset and also have an open work order? Return the store, freezer, anomaly count, maximum temperature, work order, and priority.

checks.metricViewSql: SELECT `Freezer ID` AS freezer_id, MEASURE(`Over-temperature Reading Count`) AS anomaly_count, MEASURE(`Maximum Temperature C`) AS maximum_temperature_c FROM {schema}.freezer_health_metrics WHERE `Freezer ID` = :freezer_id GROUP BY ALL
checks.groundTruthSql: WITH bounds AS (SELECT MAX(event_time) AS latest_event_time FROM {schema}.telemetry), anomalies AS (SELECT freezer_id, COUNT_IF(temperature_c > -15) AS anomaly_count, MAX(temperature_c) AS maximum_temperature_c FROM {schema}.telemetry CROSS JOIN bounds WHERE event_time > latest_event_time - INTERVAL 24 HOURS AND event_time <= latest_event_time GROUP BY freezer_id) SELECT s.store_name, f.freezer_id, a.anomaly_count, a.maximum_temperature_c, w.work_order_id, w.priority FROM anomalies a JOIN {schema}.freezers f ON a.freezer_id = f.freezer_id JOIN {schema}.stores s ON f.store_id = s.store_id JOIN {schema}.work_orders w ON w.freezer_id = f.freezer_id WHERE f.criticality = 'High' AND a.anomaly_count >= 3 AND w.status IN ('Open', 'In Progress') ORDER BY f.freezer_id
